name: What steps can I take to prevent mold growth in my commercial property?

mainEntity.name: What steps can I take to prevent mold growth in my commercial property?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent mold growth in your commercial property, focus on controlling moisture. Promptly repair all leaks, address any plumbing issues immediately, and ensure proper ventilation in moisture-prone areas like bathrooms and utility rooms. Maintain indoor humidity levels below 60% through air conditioning or dehumidifiers. Regularly inspect your property for water intrusion or dampness, especially after heavy rains, and ensure good drainage around the building.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by controlling moisture, repairing leaks, ensuring proper ventilation, maintaining low humidity, and regularly inspecting for dampness.
